variants.user_notes: The Alhambra II, uploaded with iceprog instead of openFPGALoader.
variants.maintainer_notes: Apio 0.8.0 programmed the Alhambra II with iceprog. The command is the one the catalog's iceprog boards use, such as the Icezum Alhambra, which has the same FTDI USB chip. Tested on an Alhambra II v1.0A on 2026-11-07.
